title: M60 lua LUA-00 — every analyzer node-type/field literal is emitted and reachable
rationale: Five childForFieldName literals in the lua analyzer name fields the pinned grammar does not have, and each sits behind a `|| namedChild(0)` fallback that converts a dead path into a silent wrong answer. M14.0.F1 reports lua grammar:fail for the same five but has no reachability notion and does not fail the build. This gate is the permanent gate the F7 rule requires BEFORE such a fix counts as landed.

checks.name: the analyzer has literals to check
every node-type literal names a type the grammar emits
every field literal resolves on some node
every field literal is reachable on the node it is asked of
every mutant was actually planted in the source
every planted regression is caught by the gate itself
the real analyzer file was not mutated by the mutant run

detail.name: invented node type
violations: node type "function_declarashun" is never emitted by the grammar (line 289)
field "name" (line 557) is asked of function_declarashun, but the grammar only resolves it on: field, for_numeric_clause, function_call, function_declaration, parameters, variable_list

detail.name: invented field literal
violations: field "argumenz" resolves on no node in the grammar (line 1108)

detail.name: field asked of the wrong node (reachable nowhere at that site)
violations: field "method" (line 302) is asked of return_statement, but the grammar only resolves it on: method_index_expression

limitations: Reachability attributes each field site to the nearest enclosing `case "type"`; a literal inside a helper method called from several dispatch sites is attributed to the method's own context and is reported as reachable-if-anywhere. This is a known softness, recorded rather than hidden.
The probe is one file. It exercises each extraction path but is not a corpus; a literal that only appears on a rare shape would read as unreachable here and need a wider probe.
